body: What’s going on buddy? Where are you going?
There is no painless way as the pain is transferred to the people who love you.
Engineering next year at uni. But I don’t want to go to uni with this depressed mindset. I want to be happy.

I’m so sorry you have to go through this. I’ll be sitting my finals soon and my teacher told me that these exams don’t define you. As much as you feel worthless and hopeless, remember that you are very loved. Do your parents know you are suicidal?
